Lip liner: permitted.
21 CFR 74.2330(b) states: "D&C Red No. 30 may be safely used for coloring cosmetics generally in amounts consistent with current good manufacturing practice." [2].
Eye shadow: not permitted.
21 CFR 70.3(s) states: "The term area of the eye means the area enclosed with in the circumference of the supra-orbital ridge and the infra-orbital ridge, including the eyebrow, the skin below the eyebrow, the eyelids and the eyelashes, and conjunctival sac of the eye, the eyeball, and the soft areolar tissue that lies within the perimeter of the infra-orbital ridge." [6].
21 CFR 70.5(a) states: "No listing or certification of a color additive shall be considered to authorize the use of any such color additive in any article intended for use in the area of the eye unless such listing or certification of such color additive specifically provides for such use." [7].
Use limit: no percentage is stated; the amount is consistent with good manufacturing practice [2].
21 CFR 74.2330(a) states: "The color additive D&C Red No. 30 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1330 (a)(1) and (b)." [1].
21 CFR 74.2330(c) states: "The label of the color additive shall conform to the requirements of § 70.25 of this chapter." [3].
21 CFR 74.2330(d) states: "All batches of D&C Red No. 30 shall be certified in accordance with regulations in part 80 of this chapter." [4].
21 CFR 82.1330 states: "The color additive D&C Red No. 30 shall conform in identity and specifications to the requirements of § 74.1330 (a)(1) and (b) of this chapter." [5].
21 CFR 82.1050 states: "A batch of a straight color listed in this subpart may be certified, in accordance with the provisions of this part, for use only in drugs and cosmetics, if such batch conforms to the requirements of § 82.5 and to the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color." [8].
